poll_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between polls for device-mapper events.

dbus_socket.description: Path to D-Bus system socket for event subscription. Leave empty to disable D-Bus.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle concurrent events.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file for the dmeventd daemon.

log_file.description: Absolute path to a log file. Empty means logs only to syslog/journald.

background_processing.description: When true, events are processed asynchronously in background threads.

targets.description: List of device types and paths to monitor for events (e.g., LVM logical volumes).

path.description: Device mapper path pattern or full DM device path (e.g., '/dev/mapper/vg-lv').

polling_enabled.description: Enable polling (vs. relying solely on async notifications) for this target.

event_types.description: List of event types to monitor (e.g., 'ERROR', 'THRESHOLD', 'STATUS').

items.description: Type of event to trigger on. Common: 'ERROR', 'THRESHOLD', 'STATUS'.
